actions.title: Switch the vehicle off
actions.instruction: Stop the engine and switch the vehicle off before opening the glove-box filter housing.

actions.title: Open the glove box and remove the inner cover
actions.instruction: Open the glove box, then remove the small inner cover that gives access to the cabin-filter housing.

actions.title: Remove the cabin-filter cover
actions.instruction: Release and remove the cabin-air-filter cover from the housing behind the glove box.

actions.title: Replace the cabin air filter
actions.instruction: Remove the old filter and install the replacement with its UP marks facing upward.

actions.title: Restore the filter housing and glove box
actions.instruction: Reinstall the cabin-filter cover and the glove-box inner cover, then close the glove box.
